authority.direction: A sealed task envelope must be immutable, and an immutable APatch runtime must not be shadowed in verification children.

reason: Studio integration exposed two fail-open edges after 0.8.39: validate_task_envelope silently resealed a modified sealed document, and verify subprocesses could inherit a foreign APatch checkout through PYTHONPATH.
implementation_plan: Verify an existing task-envelope document_hash before normalization or resealing.
Remove only PYTHONPATH entries that expose a foreign APatch package while preserving unrelated user entries and the running APatch package root.
Keep launcher isolation and ordinary workspace verification behavior unchanged.
verify_commands: python3 -m pytest tests/test_sdd_integrity.py tests/test_sdd_mandatory_profile.py tests/test_workspace_launcher.py tests/test_tool_paths.py -q
